LanguageData.FeatherMedals_NoTrophies: Not yet adorned with any trophies.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyDesc: Gather colonists to adorn a warrior with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledAlreadyAwarded: Someone has already been adorned with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledRequiresPresenter: Requires a colonist holding one of these roles: {SPEAKERS}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledCeremonyInProgress: An adorning ceremony for this trophy is already in progress.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledNotOnGround: The trophy must be put down before starting an adorning ceremony.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledCitationLocked: The deeds in the Tale of Honor cannot be changed after the adorning.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CitationDesc: Write or edit the Tale of Honor about the deeds this trophy represents.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyAttendance_ToolTip: Up to {QUALITY} of adorning quality. More colonists make a more meaningful adorning.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyVenue_ToolTip: Up to {QUALITY} of adorning quality. Hold the adorning in an impressive room for a better outcome.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_Written_T: {QUALITY} of adorning quality. The Tale of Honor adds weight and meaning to the trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_None_Tool: No Tale of Honor written. You will be prompted during the adorning, or write one before the adorning for a {QUALITY} bonus to adorning quality.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyTrophyQuality_Tool: How much care was put into making and selecting the trophy. A legendary trophy adds up to {MAX} of adorning quality, an awful one takes up to {MIN} away.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Ceremony_Started: {LEADER_labelShort} has begun the adorning ceremony for {PAWN_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Ceremony_Failed_TrophyLost: The trophy was lost before {PAWN_labelShort} could be adorned.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_WriteCitationDesc: Tell the Tale of Honor, recounting the deeds of a warrior. The tale cannot be changed after the adorning.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine1: {PAWN_labelShort} has been ceremonially adorned with a {TROPHY} by {PRESENTER_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine2: The {QUALITY} adorning ceremony was attended by {ATTENDEES} tribe members, and the deeds of {PAWN_labelShort} have been recognized by the tribe.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyLocked: This trophy is locked and cannot be removed. Click to unlock.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyUnlocked: This trophy is unlocked and can be removed. Click to lock.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyNeedsCeremony: Trophies can only be given through an adorning ceremony
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyBiocoded: This trophy belongs to {PAWN_labelShort}, {IMPOSTOR_labelShort} cannot wear it.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_MustHoldSpeakerRole: Must hold one of these roles: {SPEAKERS}.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophy_CannotBeAdornedWith: {PAWN_labelShort} cannot be adorned with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_StatDraw_AddTrait_Desc: May grant the {TRAIT} trait when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_StatDraw_RemoveTrait_Desc: May remove the {TRAIT} trait when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyRemovedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has shed the {TRAIT} trait through this honor.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyAddedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has gained the {TRAIT} trait through this honor.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_HW_ForbiddenRole: {PAWN_nameDef}'s beliefs forbid taking part in adorning ceremonies.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_LockTrophyUponAwa: If enabled, a trophy is locked by default once a colonist is adorned with it, and cannot be removed. This can be toggled per trophy on the Trophies tab. This setting does not affect biocoding. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_PromptForCitation: Prompt for a Tale of Honor during Ceremonies

If enabled, a dialog will appear during adorning ceremonies to enter a Tale of Honor for the trophy, if it does not have one yet. If disabled, no dialog will appear, but a Tale of Honor can still be written before the ceremony starts. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_AutoGenerateCitat: If enabled, a Tale of Honor will be suggested when the dialog opens and none has been written yet. Default: OFF
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_TrophyDynamicTrai: If enabled, trophies can have a dynamic effect on traits such as gaining the elder trait or losing wimp when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_DrawTrophiesOnPaw: If enabled, worn trophies will be drawn on pawns. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_WornSize_Tooltip: Size of trophies drawn on pawns. Default: 130%
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_VerticalBias_Tool: Controls how much feathers fan out. 0% - straight up, 100% - fanned out. Default: 35%
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_CenterZ_Tooltip: Moves trophies higher or lower. Default: 0.1
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_DisplayedTrophies: Number of trophies drawn on a pawn. Trophies over this count are still worn, but not drawn. Default: 9
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_GenerateNpcTrophi: Pawns from other factions can spawn already adorned with trophies. Existing pawns are not changed. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_NpcTech_Tooltip: Tech level of factions considered to spawn with trophies. Default: Animal-Medieval
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_ShowScalpinGizm: Pawns and corpses will have a gizmo to order colonists to scalp them. Scalping is still available from the right-click menu and the Orders menu. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_ScalpBreaksTarg: Scalping mental breaks can target children
The scalping frenzy and prisoner scalping mental breaks can target children and babies. Default: OFF
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_GenerateScalped: Pawns from other factions can spawn with an old scalping scar. Chance is 5% for animal-level factions and falls linearly to 0% for spacer-level and higher. Default: ON
